why: owner 25 Nov: release the new version (1.0.8)

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.8-beta for WoW Forever 1.60.1.71091

New
- NPC talk and books (settings page 'NPC talk and books'): the gossip window and the quest greeting, what NPCs say / yell / emote in the chat and in their speech bubbles, books, letters and plaques. Every text that has no Persian yet is kept in English in the status report and in the harvest file, so the next update has it.
- Hold Shift = the game's English original (spell and talent tooltips, the talk pane, NPC chat lines). Switch: General.
- Status page: 'WoWFA.lua folder' - one click selects the full folder path (Ctrl+C, then Win+R, Ctrl+V, Enter opens it), plus 'Save the file (/reload)'. Fix the path once (other drive, your account folder) and it is remembered.

Translations
- About 400 more place names in Persian: town halls, inns and taverns (Darkshire Town Hall, Scarlet Raven Tavern...), city districts (Stormwind, Ironforge, Orgrimmar, Undercity), dungeon and raid rooms, battlegrounds, and the new WoW Forever areas (Zephras Isle, Shaper's Terrace, Drowned City, Blackmaw Hold).
- About 50 more game alerts in Persian ('The merchant doesn't want that item.', 'You are too full to eat more now.', stunned / silenced / mounted / bag full / loot messages...).

Fixes
- Persian chat: a new chat font (WoWFA Chat) whose English letters look like the game's own chat font, at the game's own size. English lines no longer look stretched or blurry.
- Reset all settings keeps your saved profiles and the WoWFA.lua path, and puts every font back at once.
- From your reports: '(Complete)' on finished objectives, the 'Quests: 9/40' line, and the alerts 'You need to be closer...', 'You don't have a pet!', 'Thank you for your report!'.
- Correct colours: plain words are no longer coloured as spells (e.g. 'cleansing' in Improved Mend Pet); professions, creature types and races get the term colour; ordinary words like 'increases' or 'chance' are plain text (942 fixes).
- Item names in objectives stay English until the full item bank arrives.
